name: Remote control panel and emergency shut-in
function: The panel outside the red zone with one control and position indicator per actuated valve, and the emergency shut-in control that closes the designated valves together.

tabs.overview: Each valve has an open and close control and a lamp or indicator fed from the actuator position switch. The emergency shut-in closes the upper master and wing valves on all trees, or a chosen set, in one action; which valves are on the shut-in list is agreed before the job.
tabs.engineering: Electrical or hydraulic pilot controls; panel rated for outdoor use.
tabs.safety: The shut-in drill is run before the first stage so everyone knows what closes and what stays open. Position lamps are a control indication, not proof of isolation.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
